 Print Actor Sharad Kapoor has revealed that several members of the film industry, including Salman Khan , Shah Rukh Khan and Sonu Sood , have reached out to him amid concerns over his well-being. The actor, whose recent videos on social media had left fans worried, said he was deeply touched by the support and affection he received from his colleagues. In an interview shared on Varinder Chawla’s YouTube channel, Sharad spoke about the calls and messages he received from people in the industry. Asked whether anyone had checked on him, he said, “You won’t believe… Everybody. From small to big, everybody. Everyone was concerned. Sonu Sood, Salman Khan, Shah Rukh Khan, Rajpal Yadav , Javed Akhtar , like everybody. I am very thankful to them. My friend Armaan Kohli… Everybody was really worried. (They said) whatever you need. I have a few journalist friends and they said we have hospitals here, wherever you want to go. That kind of overwhelming love…” Sharad has been part of several films across the 1990s and 2000s, including Josh, Dastak, Khauff, Kyo Kii… Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta, Jaani Dushman: Ek Anokhi Kahani, Yeh Hai Jalwa and Lakshya. He later appeared in films such as Jai Ho and Jabariya Jodi. The 2019 release, starring Parineeti Chopra and Sidharth Malhotra, was among his last prominent film appearances. Over the years, he has shared screen space with actors such as Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Govinda and Amitabh Bachchan. During the same conversation, Sharad was also asked whether the film industry tends to forget actors when they are no longer seen in films regularly. He disagreed, saying that people do not forget their colleagues but may be occupied with their own commitments. According to him, if someone approaches them for work and an opportunity is available, “they will never deny.” The actor also recalled getting his first break with Dastak, produced by Mahesh Bhatt and marking Sushmita Sen’s debut. He said Mahesh would make an effort to help anyone in need if he came to know about their situation. Sharad recently met Sonu Sood and spoke warmly about the actor’s gesture of support. Describing him as an “outstanding man,” Sharad said Sonu had offered to get his house painted or extend any other help he could. He added, “God forbid if he needs any help, I will be the first one to help him. What a wonderful human being!” Join conversation

 While he is currently prioritising his health, Sharad also revealed that he has been discussing potential film projects with Ahmed Khan and Rohit Shetty and may sign them soon. “Maybe from 2027, I will be back in action,” he said. Earlier, Sharad’s friend Hema Chaudhary, who runs the animal welfare organisation Bezubaan Trust, had expressed concern about his condition and said he needed assistance. She also criticised an individual who allegedly filmed himself helping the actor. “Another guy took him somewhere, gave him cash, and made a video showing he was helping him. This is called publicity, not help. You are mocking his situation to increase your followers,” Hema claimed. Concerns about Sharad’s circumstances emerged after a video of him giving away his pets to a trust went viral on social media a few days ago. The clip prompted questions about his health, financial condition and the state of his home.
